reports.title: APPLIED MATERIALS ANNOUNCES FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Applied’s total revenue and non-GAAP diluted EPS for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 are expected to be as follows:
Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year Reportable Segment Information

Effective in the first quarter of fiscal 2026, management moved our 200-millimeter equipment business to Semiconductor Systems. The business was previously included in Applied Global Services. Additionally, effective in the first quarter of fiscal 2026, management began fully allocating corporate support costs to our operating segments. Prior-period numbers have been recast to conform to the current-year presentation. Display operating segment financial results are included in the Other category balances below.

desk.headline: Record revenue up 53% to $10.41bn and adjusted EPS up 92% to $4.16, both beat; Q1 outlook of $11.1bn revenue and $4.35 EPS
results: Record quarter: revenue rose 53% to $10.41bn and adjusted EPS nearly doubled (+92%) to $4.16; GAAP EPS of $3.40 was held back by a $653m paper loss on strategic investments.
Chip-equipment sales (Semiconductor Systems) jumped 64% to $8.0bn, with DRAM taking a bigger share (33% vs 28%); services grew 26% to $1.9bn.
Margins widened: adjusted gross margin 50.6% (+2.5 pts) and a record adjusted operating margin of 35.3%.
China's share of sales fell to 25% from 29% as Taiwan, Korea and the US grew faster.
Record free cash flow of $2.6bn; $2.42bn returned ($2.0bn buyback, the largest in over eight years, plus $421m dividends). Full-year revenue was a record $34.45bn, up 21%.

guidance.summary: For the January quarter (Q1 FY27) Applied expects revenue of about $11.1bn (plus or minus $0.5bn) and adjusted EPS of about $4.35 (plus or minus $0.20), both above the quarter just reported. It also says Semiconductor Systems is on track to grow more than 40% in calendar 2026.

points: Management said demand for advanced chips still far exceeds supply, and expects wafer-fab equipment spending to rise more than 30% in 2027, with Applied growing faster than the market.
Leading-edge DRAM (including HBM for AI) and advanced packaging are seen as the fastest growers; DRAM had a record quarter.
China should still grow in 2027 but more slowly than AI-driven markets, falling below 25% of the business.
Supply pinch points and limited clean-room space are the main brakes; Q1 would be slightly higher with perfect parts supply. Applied plans to double systems output by 2028.
Adjusted gross margin is guided to about 50.8% in Q1 and expected to keep improving through 2027; services seen growing around 15% a year.

watch: Whether supply bottlenecks and clean-room shortages cap shipments against strong AI-driven orders.
Gross margin progress above 50.8% as new-tool pricing offsets ramp costs.
China's share of sales and any change in export rules.
